channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Fim de sigilo do Master é parcial, e o árbitro do que vem à luz é Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin signaled compliance with a request from the left and President Lula, but kept the most sensitive aspects of the Master case under seal under André Mendonça.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta sexta (11/9)
item.description: Seven candidates for governor of São Paulo carry out campaign activities on Friday (11/9), with emphasis on incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad, the leaders in voter intention polls. The events include debates, rallies and interviews in various cities across the state. The race remains highly competitive, especially between the governor seeking reelection and the former minister of finance.

item.title: Haddad e Tarcísio escolhem Vale do Paraíba para corpo-a-corpo com eleitor
item.description: The São Paulo gubernatorial candidates, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT), campaign separately in the Vale do Paraíba region. Tarcísio visits a school in São José dos Campos and holds closed-door events, while Haddad participates in open gatherings in Aparecida and Pindamonhangaba. Their strategies diverge: Tarcísio focuses on the capital and restricted events, leading polls with 42% support versus Haddad's 27%.

item.title: Há 7 meses, PF ligava Toffoli a pagamento de R$ 35 mi de Vorcaro
item.description: A Police Federal report from February suggested Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli was the likely owner of the Arleen fund, linked to suspicious payments of R$35 million from Daniel Vorcaro. The PF also investigated possible Vorcaro influence over Toffoli's vote on sugar-alcohol plant precatories. The case was reassigned to Justice André Mendonça after a secret meeting among Supreme Court justices.

item.title: Candidato que associou funk ao crime em CPI usa ritmo em jingle de campanha
item.description: Vereador Lucas Pavanato (PL), who reported on the Pancadões CPI in São Paulo and linked funk music to organized crime, used the genre in campaign jingles for the Chamber of Deputies. During the commission, he argued that clandestine parties and beatdowns are tied to narcoculture, drug trafficking, and violence. He also led the complaint that led to the early closure of a funk exhibition at the Museu da Língua Portuguesa.

item.title: Eleições 2026: conheça slogans dos candidatos que estarão nas urnas em SP
item.description: The 2026 elections in São Paulo showcase strategic slogans from candidates, with Lula using 'For a Sovereign Brazil' and Haddad with 'Awaken SP', while Tarcísio and Flávio emphasize messages of continuity and victory. Jingles and communications aim to connect proposals with the electorate, highlighting themes such as sovereignty, development, and overcoming challenges.

item.title: Fachin pede e Mendonça anuncia fim do sigilo do caso Master; arquivos devem vir a público nesta sexta-feira
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin requested Justice Minister André Mendonça to lift the confidentiality of parts of the Master case investigation, involving financial fraud allegations against Banco Master and its owner, Daniel Vorcaro. The decision will release documents and petitions related to the case, including Petition 15.556, the original of Operation Compliance Zero. A plenary session scheduled for September 15th may address a potential investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento sobre mudanças na Lei da Ficha Limpa; resultado pode afetar candidaturas suspensas
item.description: The STF resumes the trial regarding changes to the Clean Record Act, which reduce the ineligibility period for convicted politicians, potentially affecting suspended candidacies in Electoral Courts. Minister Gilmar Mendes is expected to present a dissenting vote, questioning the validity of part of the amendments approved by Congress.

item.title: Datafolha divulga novas pesquisas eleitorais nesta sexta (11)
item.description: Datafolha releases on Friday (11) a new round of electoral polls with data from the presidential race and contests for the governorships of São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Pernambuco, and the Federal District. The polls were commissioned by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: André Mendonça atende a pedido de Fachin e retira sigilo de investigações do Banco Master
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, responding to a request from President Edson Fachin, lifted the seals on part of the Banco Master investigations, except for certain ones such as the funding of the film Dark Horse and those involving Senator Ciro Nogueira. The decision covers PET 15.556, considered the leading investigation, and other related procedures into the Banco Master scheme.

item.title: Pesquisa não me abala, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an interview with SBT Brasil that election polls do not shake him and stressed the need to focus on campaigning. A PoderData/Aya survey shows he trails Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical runoff, but Lula noted his experience in past elections and described polls as a guide to refine strategies.

item.title: Observatório do STF cobra de Fachin proteção à corte e critica ministros que querem influenciar eleição
item.description: The STF Observatory sent a letter to President Edson Fachin expressing concern over ministers seeking to influence the electoral process, amid an unprecedented crisis within the court.

item.title: Condenação de Bolsonaro completa um ano com STF em crise e clã na disputa pela Presidência
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's conviction for attempted coup completes one year amid the Supreme Court's worst crisis and Flávio Bolsonaro running for president. The institution faces unprecedented challenges as the family remains involved in political dispute.

item.title: Fachin solicita que Mendonça retire o sigilo de parte das investigações sobre o Banco Master
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, requested Minister André Mendonça to declassify parts of the Banco Master investigation, citing the need for transparency before a potential inquiry into Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The case management changed after the arrest of Daniel Vorcaro, linked to alleged accounting frauds.

item.title: Fachin determina que Mendonça levante sigilo do Caso Master
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin ordered minister André Mendonça to lift the seal on Master Case investigations, which allege ties between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. The decision comes amid a crisis within the Court, marked by mutual accusations between justices, and the plenary will address the issue next Tuesday.

item.title: Fachin derruba sigilo das investigações do caso Master
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin ordered the suspension of conflicting decisions by ministers André Mendonça and Flávio Dino regarding the Master case and canceled plenary sessions to convene the justices and seek a resolution to the internal crisis at the top court.

item.title: Governo Trump monitora crise no STF e considera novas sanções contra Moraes e aliados
item.description: The Trump administration considers new sanctions against Brazilian authorities, including Moraes, due to the STF crisis. A high-ranking State Department official confirmed that measures are prepared for potential adoption. The tension involves security and governance issues.

item.title: PT diz que STF vive “guerra” e pede fim de “privilégios” no Judiciário
item.description: The PT published a resolution criticizing the STF for allegedly waging a 'war' and demanded reforms in the Judiciary, such as the end of privileges, creation of terms and greater transparency. The national leadership, led by Edinho Silva, defended structural changes in the justice system, including social control and strict ethics.

item.title: Mário Frias e empresa investigada transferiram R$ 1,4 milhão para produtora de 'Dark Horse', aponta PF
item.description: Federal Police identified transfers of R$1.4 million from Deputy Mário Frias and NTT Brasil to Go Up Entertainment, the producer of the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. The amounts raised suspicions due to Frias' low monthly income of R$44,000. The investigation points to possible misuse of parliamentary amendments.

item.title: Lula: Pesquisas não me abalam, são reflexo para saber o que fazer dali para frente
item.description: In an interview with SBT News, President Lula stated that poll numbers do not unsettle him and serve as a diagnostic to guide future actions. He emphasized that the race against Flávio Bolsonaro is dynamic and that the campaign will remain focused on governance and social rights. Lula highlighted that the final stretch demands broad articulation to solidify his national proposal.

item.title: Lula diz que tomará decisão sobre bets com base em discussão com sociedade, mas não cita medida
item.description: Lula said he will decide on the operation of bets based on discussions with society and experts, without predicting the measure. In an interview with SBT News, the president highlighted the meeting held at Planalto Palace but avoided detailing the possible regulation.

item.title: No meu governo não tem essa de ficar discutindo ajuste fiscal, faço ajuste na prática, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with SBT News that his administration focuses on practical adjustments rather than theoretical fiscal debates, citing his previous terms as evidence of fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Lula diz que encontro com Vorcaro serviu para dizer que Master seria investigado com seriedade
item.description: President Lula stated that during a meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro in December 2024, he assured that the Master Bank would be investigated seriously after its closure due to government action. Lula emphasized that the investigation will be conducted with institutional rigor.

item.title: Produtora de “Dark Horse” diz que entregou “mais de 20.000 laudas” à PF
item.description: The producer of the film 'Dark Horse', Karina Ferreira da Gama, stated she delivered over 20,000 pages of documents to the Federal Police before the 'Make Up' operation, which investigates suspected irregular funding of the film about Jair Bolsonaro. Her defense claims this demonstrates good faith and filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Court challenging procedural aspects of the operation.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a senador por Minas Gerais (MG) nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Seventeen politicians are competing for two seats in the Federal Senate for Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections. Notable candidates include Marília Campos (PT), Aécio Neves (PSDB), Carlos Viana (PSD), and Domingos Sávio (PL), in a highly competitive and polarized race. Carlos Viana is the only incumbent seeking reelection.

item.title: A declaração de Lula após decisões de Fachin sobre Moraes, Mendonça, Dino e Andrei Rodrigues
item.description: Lula stated that Fachin is bringing order to the Court and advocated for opening files to restore the STF's credibility. He also suggested discussing term limits for ministers.

item.title: PoderData: Lula e Flávio empatam no primeiro turno; Mateus Netzel analisa | JP ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: A new PoderData poll shows a tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of the 2026 elections. Mateus Netzel analyzes the current electoral dynamics and the Brazilian political scenario.

item.title: Tarcísio ataca atuais senadores de São Paulo: "Alguém lembra os nomes?"
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized the current São Paulo senators, questioning the effectiveness of their terms and calling for representatives closer to the population. He promoted candidate André do Prado, who also attacked the senators in recent speeches.

item.title: Lula defende discutir mandato para ministros do STF
item.description: President Lula (PT) advocated for term limits for Supreme Federal Court (STF) justices, arguing no one should hold the same position for 40 years. He emphasized the need to discuss judicial reforms to prevent excessive concentration of power. This statement reinforces his stance on institutional reforms.

item.title: Sem citar Mendonça, Lula diz que juiz não pode vazar só o que o interessa
item.description: Lula criticized selective leaks by judges, such as André Mendonça, and demanded transparency in the Supreme Court to avoid harming democracy and elections. He praised Edson Fachin for managing the crisis and stated that all involved in the Master case must comply with the Constitution.

item.title: CNBB manifesta em preocupação com as instituições democráticas e defende Código de Ética no STF
item.description: The CNBB expressed concern over the crisis involving the STF and advocated for transparency, demanding collegial and public investigations. The statement supports the STF Ethics Code and warns about the need to preserve democratic institutions, especially during the election period.

item.title: PABLO MARÇAL AO VIVO | ELEIÇÕES 2026 | CHEGA DE PT
item.description: Live video of Pablo Marçal discussing the 2026 elections, criticizing the Workers' Party (PT) and promoting a narrative of change. The content includes commentary on Brazilian politics and potential proposals for the future.

item.title: Lula: Vorcaro reclamou de perseguição em único encontro que teve com ele
item.description: President Lula stated that his only meeting with Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master occurred in 2024, during which the banker complained about persecution but was told he would be investigated with due seriousness. Lula likened the situation to the Banco Panamericano case and emphasized the severity of financial irregularities involving Vorcaro.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da resolução da Executiva do PT que aborda crise do STF
item.description: The PT published a resolution addressing the crisis at the STF, calling for transparency and initiating debate on term limits in superior courts. The Executive describes the Court as engaging in 'blind warfare' and expresses confidence in STF President Justice Edson Fachin.

item.title: Andrei tem minha total confiança, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula expressed full trust in Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, praising his experience and anti-crime operations amid criticism over his political appointment.

item.title: Faria Lima só chora e não conhece a palavra social, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula criticized the financial market, claiming Faria Lima 'only cries' and ignores social priorities. He advocated for investments in education, artificial intelligence, and critical minerals, highlighting public debt at 82.5% of GDP and reaffirming his fiscal surplus record.

item.title: Levantamento aponta uso de IA sem identificação por candidatos
item.description: A survey by Observatório Lupa found 37 official candidate posts using undisclosed AI among 314 suspicious contents collected between August 16-26. Most were deepfakes, with Lula as the main target (115 instances) and Flávio Bolsonaro second (56). The TSE reiterates the ban on AI use in campaigns without disclosure.

item.title: Inflação dos alimentos foi de 54,2% no governo Bolsonaro. No governo Lula, de 13,6%. Mas o consumidor não sente alívio
item.description: IPC data reveals food price inflation reached 54.2% under Bolsonaro and 13.6% under Lula, indicating consumer relief. The opposition attempts to shift focus, yet the figures point to improved management in the prior administration.

item.title: Lula defende debate sobre mandatos para ministros do STF
item.description: President Lula advocated for the establishment of term limits for STF ministers, criticizing long tenures in the same position. He also addressed the ongoing crisis at the Supreme Court, including investigations against Moraes, and emphasized initiatives like PEC 16/2019, which proposes eight-year terms.

item.title: Master, Moraes e Flávio Bolsonaro: os contratos sob suspeita
item.description: In Papo Antagonista, Carlo Cauti and Luciano da Luz discuss million-dollar contracts involving the wife of Alexandre de Moraes and Banco Master, as well as an audio of Flávio Bolsonaro asking for money from Daniel Vorcaro, raising concerns about the independence of the Federal Police.

item.title: Se Alexandre de Moraes for culpado, ele tem que pagar, diz Lula
item.description: Lula stated that if Alexandre de Moraes is found guilty in the Banco Master crisis, he must face consequences, emphasizing that everyone must comply with the Constitution. He again called for the lifting of secrecy and criticized the alleged influence of the bank over political figures, without naming Flávio Bolsonaro directly. A new PoderData/Aya poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio in a potential runoff.

item.title: Produtora de “Dark Horse” faz documento e cita pressão por delação
item.description: Entrepreneur Karina Ferreira da Gama, investigated over budget amendments used for the film 'Dark Horse', claimed she was pressured into signing a plea bargain, mentioning contacts with Fernando Sarney and others. The Police Federal operation, authorized by Minister Flávio Dino, probes alleged irregularities in financing the biographical documentary of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Fachin agiu corretamente e espero que coloque ordem na casa, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin acted correctly by taking measures to stabilize the institutional crisis at the Supreme Court, including revoking Moraes' assignment and suspending rulings from other justices. Lula supported opening investigations' secrecy and criticized selective leaks, emphasizing the need to restore the Court's prestige.

item.title: STF debate rito para sessão sobre conversas de Vorcaro com Moraes; leia perguntas e respostas
item.description: The STF will debate the procedural rules for a session regarding conversations between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes, identifying the latter as the interlocutor. The Federal Police report will be analyzed by the full court next week.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’ vira pangaré e possível efeito eleitoral chega tarde para Flávio e Lula
item.description: The film 'Dark Horse', portraying Jair Bolsonaro, failed to serve as an effective campaign tool for Flávio Bolsonaro due to its delayed release and entrenched voter polarization. For Lula, the content lacks significant impact, as prior scandals and investigations have already been absorbed without strong reactions. The Vorcaro case, involving R$130 million requested by Flávio, remains the biggest damage to the Bolsonarist image.

item.title: Fachin coloca ‘ordem na casa’ com decisões, diz Lula
item.description: Lula supports Fachin's decisions to restore order at the STF amid internal ministerial tensions. He backs investigations and discusses term limits for justices.

item.title: Lula sai em defesa de Andrei: 'é da minha total confiança'
item.description: President Lula publicly defended the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, stating he is fully trusted and praising his efficiency in combating organized crime. The defense follows Supreme Court fluctuations between suspension and reinstatement of the removal decision, creating instability in the position.

item.title: Flávio diz que operação sobre 'Dark Horse' é tentativa de golpe e fala em acionar Fachin contra Dino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro questions a Federal Police operation regarding alleged congressional amendments supposedly directed at the producer of the film 'Dark Horse,' calling it an attempted coup. He states he will file lawsuits against the former judge and the Minister of Justice to investigate the Minister of Justice and the Minister of Economy, following the operation during the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Lula defende mandato para ministro do STF e diz que Fachin deve fazer mais para ‘pôr ordem na casa’
item.description: Lula advocates for term limits for Supreme Court justices and criticizes lifetime tenure, calling for punishment of justices like Moraes and Mendonça in investigations into Banco Master frauds. He praises Fachin but demands greater transparency and accountability for all involved.

item.title: Confira como foi a quinta-feira (10) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Thursday (10), the presidential candidates carried out a varied agenda with leafleting, interviews, town halls, and events. Notable was Hertz Dias, who advocated for increased investments in education and the end of budget restrictions on public universities, and Romeu Zema, who campaigned in Ceará. Ronaldo Caiado canceled his schedule due to hospitalization.
